title: Device session lifetime policy

fields.label: Idle timeout · seconds
fields.hint: 600–2592000; current activity extends idle only within the absolute cap

fields.label: Access token lifetime · seconds
fields.hint: Short-lived access and WebSocket tickets remain bound to origin session

fields.label: Policy revision
fields.hint: Save uses exact revision; no automatic stale retry

rows.name: Current issued sessions
rows.value: Reductions immediately tighten idle and absolute caps

rows.name: New login and pairing
rows.value: Increased limits apply only to new sessions

notice: Host administrator only. Saving shorter lifetimes may expire your own session. Review unsaved work first; expired sessions and tickets cannot gain authority from refresh.

title: Policy saved or changed elsewhere

fields.label: Current policy revision
fields.hint: Illustrative result; actual host response is authoritative

fields.label: Expired sessions
fields.hint: Only a successful reduction returns its actual expired_sessions count

fields.label: Unsaved policy draft
fields.hint: Review current revision before reapplying the retained draft

fields.label: Current session
fields.value: Live · or expired by the reduction
fields.hint: Expired access requires a fresh configured sign-in; never retry old tickets

rows.name: Revision conflict
rows.value: Save rejected; no policy or session effects

notice: A stale save has no effects and keeps the draft. A successful reduction can end this session; increased values never widen existing sessions. Reauthenticate through the configured entry flow when needed.
